snippet.title: Good News Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Visit: https://elephteria.ar

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069820/Good_News
Contact: augusto.salgado@elephteria.ar
Join Discord: https://discord.gg/kcHA99Vwkh

‘Good News’ puts you in the role of the chief editor of a growing newspaper in a 1950s setting. You’ll have to correct your writers’ drafts to make sure the news is published without errors and appeals to your audience, in order to keep readership growing. As the newspaper gains more influence, you’ll have to carefully manage your relationship with important figures, as special requests will come in often and anyone can turn into a powerful ally or a dangerous foe. In this indie adventure with multiple endings and high replayability no one is entirely good nor bad.
